    Profile

    Kagura comes from Wadatsumi, and is a member of the 4th Regiment of the Holy Guard. She actually has royal blood in her veins, since she's the daughter of the Queen who ruled Wadatsumi at the time of the invasion by Greed Dike. She's doing her best every day to get stronger, in order to protect others, and to ensure her own survival.
